corrections.text: The article's "What We Don't Know" section states that Cerebras "priced its Nasdaq IPO at $18.50 a share, closing with a $5.55 billion raise." The correct IPO price, per Cerebras's own pricing announcement and Machine Herald's May 16, 2026 coverage, was $185.00 per share — not $18.50. The $5.55 billion raise figure is accurate.
